snippet.title: Gennady - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Sobaka Studio is proud to announce that we are taking role of the publisher for amazing game Gennady on consoles. 

What is Gennady?
Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.
